item.title: Fix bug in window.py so python3 -m unittest passes
item.brief: Operator request (authenticated chat): In this repository `python3 -m unittest` fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes, without changing the tests. The function must be correct for every input, not only the tested ones (check boundary cases such as empty input, size 0/1, and off-by-one edges, and do not special-case the test inputs). Commit the fix locally with a clear commit message; do not push. Do not modify test files. Keep the change minimal and readable.

reasons: sizer: elevated -> high; capped at medium; consider a stronger tier; unchanged

state.summary:
Fixed the off-by-one in window.py sliding_windows. The window loop used range(len(items) - size), which dropped the final window; it now uses range(len(items) - size + 1). Committed locally as 987c142 on archon/hanqha8t-fix-bug-in-window-py-so-python3-m-unitte (base cfa6a05); not pushed. No test files changed. Before: python3 -m unittest ran 3 tests, 2 failing (test_includes_the_last_window, test_whole_list_is_one_window). After: 3 of 3 pass on the final head. Boundary checks also pass: [] with size 1 gives [], [1] with size 1 gives [[1]], [1] with size 2 gives [], [] with size 3 gives [], and [1,2,3] with size 3 gives [[1,2,3]]. size <= 0 still raises ValueError. Reviewer agt_01M88XPNZMF7ACP44H3F73DCM3 (haiku, low effort) passed the head with no findings. Nothing is left running; the reviewer's leftover process (pid 2543516) was stopped. Untracked __pycache__ was removed. Nothing is open.

pr.body: Approach: the window count was len(items) - size, which omits the last window. Changed to len(items) - size + 1. Empty input and size > len still yield an empty range. Only window.py changed; tests unchanged. Checks: python3 -m unittest 3/3 OK on head 987c142. Reviewer passed head 987c142 with no findings. Assumptions: none beyond the existing ValueError for size <= 0.
pr.summary: sliding_windows now returns every window, including the last. before: range(len - size) dropped the final window; now: range(len - size + 1).
pr.title: Fix off-by-one that dropped the last sliding window

risk.why: One-line range bound fix in a single function. No behaviour change beyond the bug, and fully covered by the unit tests. Reviewer confirmed low.
